question: India played its first test match cricket against which of the following countries?
solution:
The correct answer is __**England**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India played its first Test match against **England** in 1932.
 
• The match took place at the **Lord's Cricket Ground** in London from June 25 to June 28, 1932.
 
• This was a historic event as it marked India's debut in the arena of Test cricket.
 
• The Indian team was led by **CK Nayudu**, who was the captain of the team.
 
• Although India lost the match, this event is significant as it laid the foundation for the future of Indian cricket.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **West Indies**__

 __
 
• The **West Indies** cricket team represents a collection of Caribbean countries and territories.
 
• India played its first Test series against the West Indies in 1952.
 
 
 
• **Australia**__
 __
 
• Australia is known for its strong cricketing history and has been one of the dominant teams in international cricket.
 
• India played its first Test series against Australia in 1947-48.
 
 
 
• **New Zealand**__
 
 
• New Zealand is also a prominent cricketing nation and has a competitive cricket team.
 
• India played its first Test series against New Zealand in 1955-56.
